title: Forbidden Land
next_chapter_hook: "What earth-shattering secret does that figure claiming to be an ancestor conceal? And why is Mo Xiansheng so desperate to stop Chen Ji from further questioning?"

text.content: "Deep within the Tianqing Sect's forbidden ruins, Chen Ji ventured deeper, arriving at a dust-laden ancient altar. The space was dim and damp, the air thick with an ancient, oppressive aura. Moss crept over the stone walls, time carving mottled marks upon them. At the end of the passage, a诡异 silver glow flickered faintly, accompanied by a heart-stopping fluctuation of energy. Chen Ji slowed his pace, his expression grave. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand grew faintly warm—as if something extraordinary awaited ahead."

dialogue.content: "(A flutter of surprise in his heart) This aura... why does it feel so familiar?"

text.content: "At the center of the altar, a figure floated suspended in midair, bound by countless silver-white threads—those were the forces of time and space, forcibly sealed here. Around the figure, ancient runes blazed frantically, emanating a suffocating pressure. Though the face was blurred, its outline bore a striking resemblance to Chen Ji. The figure seemed to sense something, slowly turning its head. Empty eyes pierced through the void, gazing directly toward where Chen Ji stood."

""You've finally come." The figure spoke, its voice ancient and distant, like an echo traversing countless ages. The silver-white threads trembled violently; lightning flashed and thunder roared within the temporal rift, as if even the heavens themselves shuddered at this moment. "I have waited... so very long.""

dialogue.content: "(Forcing down the surging emotions, his face like still water) Who are you? Why are you sealed here?"

text.content: ""Who am I?" The figure let out a desolate laugh. "I am the sinner of the Chen family, the outcast of the Tianji Record, a prisoner caged by fate." The runes erupted with blinding silver radiance, illuminating the blurred features—strikingly, seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji! "But more importantly... I am your ancestor.""

"The word 'ancestor' struck like thunder in Chen Ji's ears. On the surface he remained unruffled, yet within his heart churned monstrous waves. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest burned intensely—a sign of resonance with its source. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this connection, nor did any family records contain such information—what secrets lay hidden within?"

choice.prompt: "Faced with this mysterious being claiming to be an ancestor, Chen Ji must make a choice—delve deeper to uncover the truth, or maintain vigilance against a possible trap?"

choices.description: "Since the bloodline has responded, perhaps approaching proactively might yield more clues about the Tianji Record and his own origins."
choices.risk_hint: "The other's intentions are unclear; rash contact may lead one into danger"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped forward slowly. The silver-white threads seemed to sense his approach, parting slightly. The figure watched him intently, a glimmer of relief flickering in its eyes."

dialogue.content: "(Gazing directly at the figure) Since you claim to be my ancestor, speak then—what connection do you have with my Chen family? Why are you sealed here?"

choices.description: "This person's identity is questionable; without confirming their true intentions, one should not act hastily."
choices.risk_hint: "May anger the other party, losing vital information"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not move; instead, he stepped back, his expression growing colder. The silver-white threads tightened slightly, as if sensing his wariness."

dialogue.content: "(Coldly said) Ancestor? That's rather childish. What proof do you have?"

choices.description: "First observe the surroundings, see if there are other clues or mechanisms, before deciding."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not rush to respond. Instead, he swiftly scanned the altar's perimeter. Indeed, in a concealed corner of the stone wall, he discovered a recessed slot containing a broken bamboo slip."

dialogue.content: "(Taking out the bamboo slip, examining carefully) This is... a fragment of the Chen family genealogical record!"
"(His pupils narrow slightly) Ancestor? The Chen family you speak of... which Chen family?"

text.content: ""The Eight Ancient Families; the Chen clan once held half the Tianji Record." The figure's voice grew ethereal. "Alas, that cataclysm twelve thousand years ago... the Chen bloodline was severed, leaving only a branch scattered across the Central Region." The silver-white threads shuddered violently; lightning and thunder raged within the temporal rift. "You think yourself worthless, not knowing it was your father's sacrifice that served as the final barrier left for you. Now, the Tianji Record has acknowledged its master—you have finally come...""

dialogue.content: "(After a moment of silence, then a cold laugh) What a fine speech. But you claim I'm of Chen blood, yet say the Chen clan is destroyed—words are wind. What proof do you offer?"

text.content: "The figure showed no anger; instead, it sighed. The silver-white threads suddenly loosened at one corner, and an ancient jade pendant drifted out, hovering before Chen Ji. Carved on the pendant was an archaic seal character—"Chen." Chen Ji unconsciously touched his chest—there lay a nearly identical jade pendant, the sole inheritance his father had left him before dying."

dialogue.content: "(Gripping the jade pendant in his chest tightly, eyes complex) ...What are you trying to tell me?"

text.content: ""What I want to say is..." The figure's voice suddenly softened. "Child, you think you are scheming against the world, but you fail to see that from the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, you entered an even grander game of chess." The silver-white threads began to dissipate; the temporal rift slowly healed. "Some secrets are not meant for you to know yet. But remember—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's lethal backlash becomes. Find your sister; she is the key to breaking this局.""

choice.prompt: "The figure's words shocked Chen Ji profoundly—could Chen Nian's existence be tightly bound to the Tianji Record's destiny? As the figure was about to vanish, Chen Ji had to make a choice."

choices.description: "Chen Nian was the sister he had searched for years; hearing that name alone made it impossible for him to remain calm."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party is about to vanish; there may be nothing more to ask"

dialogue.content: "(Stepping forward abruptly) Where is Chen Nian? Is she still alive?"

text.content: "The figure had begun to fade, but in its final moment, its gaze fell upon Chen Ji, filled with tenderness and expectation. "Alive... but imprisoned in a place that should not exist. Go, child. Search for her... rewrite the fate that belongs to you...""

choices.description: "The Tianji Record's lethal backlash alarmed him deeply; rather than Chen Nian's whereabouts, he wished to know how to break this curse."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party's time is limited; a complete answer may not be possible"

dialogue.content: "(Furrowing his brow tightly) Lethal backlash... you speak of the Tianji Record's price? Is there a way to break it?"

text.content: "The figure's form grew ever fainter, leaving only a mournful sigh. "The Tianji Record is itself a piece on the chessboard of heavenly will... to escape the backlash, one must leap beyond the board. But speaking of this now is premature. You need to grow stronger... strong enough to shake those lofty beings above.""

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng had been concealing something all along; since this ancestor knew so much, perhaps he could unravel the mystery surrounding Mo Xiansheng."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may be unwilling to reveal anything about Mo Xiansheng"

dialogue.content: "(Eyes sharpening) That soul remnant calling itself Mo Xiansheng... what kind of person is he? Why has he never mentioned you?"

text.content: "The figure fell silent for an instant, complex emotions flickering in its eyes. "He... is another soul imprisoned by the Tianji Record. As for why he never mentions me... our grudge runs far deeper than you could imagine." The figure dissolved into scattered silver light, vanishing into the void."

"Chen Ji stood alone before the altar, his expression shifting uncertainly. The ancestor's words echoed in his mind like thunder, each sentence seemingly concealing profound meaning. Chen Nian, the lethal backlash, Mo Xiansheng's identity... too many mysteries awaited answers. He slowly turned, his footsteps heavy as he departed the altar. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest glowed faintly warm, as if responding to something. He raised his gaze toward the distance, a resolute glint flickering in his eyes—no matter how many thorns lay ahead, he would uncover the truth step by step."
